subject: Concession pathway and capacity-bucket anchoring - commercial proposal
messages:
From: Lydia Armstrong <lydia.armstrong@globex.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@globex.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Commercial appendix + ask: concession pathway and overflow protection

Markus —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement here — attaching the commercial appendix from our RFP. A few immediate asks so we can land this into our internal committee:

- Can you provide a concrete pricing ladder (unit cost per 1k input+output tokens) for the three model classes we discussed (base open, optimized-quant, and Redwood-verified)?
- We need an explicit escrow / drawdown mechanism for bursts during seasonal peaks (Q4 traffic spike). How would Redwood protect us from surprise overages while preserving throughput?
- Please describe true-up cadence (monthly/quarterly) and how credits are applied on invoices.
- Any concession pathway if our committed volumes miss targets in Year 1 — do you offer step-down buckets or blended credits?

Also attach any one-page term summaries you typically share with procurement. We have a negotiation window next Tuesday.

Lydia Armstrong
Senior Sourcing Manager — Globex
Lydia.Armstrong@globex.com
Attachment: Globex_RFP_Commercial_Appendix.pdf (application/pdf)

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Lydia Armstrong <lydia.armstrong@globex.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commercial appendix + ask: concession pathway and overflow protection

Hi Lydia —

Thanks for the clear list. Attached is a first-pass commercial proposal and a short term summary for procurement. Below is a compact summary you can circulate to your committee; happy to walk through on Tuesday.

Key components (summary):

1) Unit pricing (list price per 1k tokens, input+output)

   - Base open model (gpt-ish open): $0.50 / 1k tokens

   - Optimized-quant variant (8-bit quant, reduced memory): $0.35 / 1k tokens

   - Redwood-verified high-accuracy variant (larger model, tuned): $0.90 / 1k tokens

2) Commit bands and blended discounts

   - Yearly committed token bands (monthly billing cadence):
     * Band A: 0 - 200M tokens / month — list pricing
     * Band B: 200M - 1B tokens / month — 12% blended discount off list
     * Band C: >1B tokens / month — 22% blended discount + priority capacity (Dedicated pool)

3) Overage and surge protection (Escrow + Cushion model)

   - Monthly true-up: usage exceeding committed monthly consumption billed at overage rate = list * 0.6 (i.e., 40% discount on list for overages) until escrow is exhausted.

   - Escrow: customer posts a refundable escrow equal to 2x average monthly committed invoice; escrow is used to auto-draw for burst overages above a configured monthly cap.

   - Cushion: We configure a rolling 72-hour burst cushion that absorbs short spikes without triggering immediate invoice overage; cushion consumption reported daily in Console.

4) Gracebands and step-down concession pathway

   - If actuals fall below 70% of annual committed volume in Year 1, Redwood offers a 2-step concession ladder:
     * Step 1 (notification + 30 days): 10% fallback on committed rate for any shortfall month (internal approval)
     * Step 2 (year-end reconciliation): remaining shortfall eligible for a blended credit applied to Year 2 baseline (up to 15% of Year 2 commit) — designed to protect both parties and avoid retroactive refunds.

5) Billing & true-up cadence

   - Invoices issued monthly; monthly true-up calculates overage/credit; annual check-point to ladder credits into next-year commit planning.

6) Model-variant discounting

   - Quantization adoption incentive: if Globex moves >=50% of inference volume to optimized-quant variants (as measured by model tag), Redwood provides an additional 8% discount on optimized-quant list price for the following 3 quarters.

7) SLA & capacity prioritization

   - Band C customers receive configured Dedicated pool access (soft reservation) and an SLA credit ladder for sustained latency breaches.

Attachments: MK_concession_proposal_v1.xlsx; term_summary_docusign_draft.pdf

Next steps: propose a 30‑min commercial run-through Monday 10:30 PT or Tuesday 08:00 PT; will loop in finance if you want decision drivers surfaced.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
Attachment: MK_concession_proposal_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 12:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commercial appendix + ask: concession pathway and overflow protection

Looping in a couple quick notes from a pricing/ops perspective (will keep it short):

- Finance will not accept an escrow that functions as a sink long-term; we should make the escrow fully refundable after Year 1 with an interest-equivalent credit (0.5% annual).
- For the overage discount (list * 0.6) we should cap the net effective discount exposure to 25% of expected monthly revenue in Band B to protect margin; propose adding an explicit overage cap clause in the appendix.
- Recommend we add a pilot clause: 3-month pilot with reduced commit (10% of Band A) and a one-time setup credit to accelerate procurement approval.

If Markus is ok, I can draft the appendix language and finance will run modeled P&L on Monday.

—Marissa
Principal Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Attachment: none

Markus / Marissa —

Appreciate the quick, detailed response. A couple clarifying questions before we share with our internal committee:

1) Is escrow refundable by default at the end of Year 1, and is the interest-equivalent credit applied to the final true-up invoice?
2) For the 72-hour rolling burst cushion — can you provide an example invoice scenario showing how cushion consumption would be reported and billed?
3) We like the pilot clause. Can you send a short DocuSign term sheet we can sign to kick off the pilot (we'd prefer the pilot start to be Jan 4).

Please send the updated one-pager and a DocuSign link and we will try to confirm in the Nov 17 negotiation window.

Thanks —
Lydia
Senior Sourcing Manager — Globex
